key.name: tor-service
key.description: Name of the systemd unit that runs the Tor daemon, for example tor.service or tor@default.service.

key.name: socks-port
key.description: Port on which Tor exposes its SOCKS proxy on localhost.

key.name: manage-proxy
key.description: Switch GNOME proxy settings to Tor while it is running and restore them afterwards.

key.name: restore-proxy
key.description: Restore the proxy configuration that was active before Tor was started. If disabled, the proxy mode is set to “none” when Tor stops.

key.name: notify-state-change
key.description: Show a desktop notification when the Tor daemon starts or stops.
